instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Use only React Native components (View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, Image, TextInput).
CRITICAL: DO NOT use HTML tags (div, span) or Tailwind classes (className) anywhere in the application.
CRITICAL: Use StyleSheet.create() for all styling in every component.
CRITICAL: Add `testID` property to all interactive and key informational elements (e.g., testID='login-button').
Ensure touch targets are at least 48x48 points for mobile accessibility.
Implement a dark theme using the provided color palette. Do not use pure black (#000000) for large backgrounds, use #0D0D12.

For Match Cards, use absolute positioning for the gradient overlay at the bottom to ensure text readability over images. Use Expo LinearGradient if possible, or a View with a transparent-to-black background.
For the Questionnaire, use a prominent progress bar and large, selectable pill buttons for answers (use surfaceElevated for unselected, primary for selected).
Implement Premium Upgrade sections with subtle gold/warm coral accents and elevated cards.
Avoid borders unless strictly necessary; prefer surface color differentiation to create depth.
Use standard Expo icons (like @expo/vector-icons) for iconography.
